name: Scatter

x.description: Input tensor, any shape (1D-4D). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

dim.description: int, axis along which to index and scatter.

index.description: Int64 tensor of indices, same rank as src. Values must be within [0, x.size(dim)).

src.description: Source tensor, same shape as index, same dtype as x.

y.description: Tensor with scattered values added in-place, same shape and dtype as x.

description:
ScatterAdd: Scatters values from src into x at the indices specified in index by addition.

Adds all values from the tensor src into x at the indices specified in the index tensor. For each value in src, its output index is specified by its index in src for dimension != dim and by the corresponding value in index for dimension = dim.

Equivalent to torch.scatter_add / aclnnScatterAdd.

For a 3-D tensor, x is updated as:
    x[index[i][j][k]][j][k] += src[i][j][k]  # if dim == 0
    x[i][index[i][j][k]][k] += src[i][j][k]  # if dim == 1
    x[i][j][index[i][j][k]] += src[i][j][k]  # if dim == 2

This is the reverse operation of torch.gather.

It is also required that index.size(d) <= src.size(d) for all dimensions d, and that index.size(d) <= x.size(d) for all dimensions d != dim.

Args: x (Tensor), dim (int), index (LongTensor), src (Tensor). Returns: Tensor, same shape/dtype as x.
